title: Answer: no account of who is conscious, and nature is said not to be

statements.text: Matter As Machine takes no position on which beings are conscious. The one place the pages assign or deny consciousness is nature as a whole: the instinct that moves people in every direction is not the work of a conscious nature that wants them to evolve, only a mechanism that proved useful, as running helps mice spread.

sources.quote: It's not that nature is conscious and wants us to evolve. No. This mechanism just appeared to be useful
